tasks.label: ТВОЯ РОЛЬ
tasks.q: Леді Кейтлін обіцяла писати тобі про все. Цього разу її лист прийшов з Орлиного Гнізда, і ти читаєш його лорду Неду вголос. Кожне речення — новий удар: небесна камера, суд, поєдинок.
tasks.q_pl: Lady Catelyn obiecała pisać ci o wszystkim. Tym razem jej list przyszedł z Orlego Gniazda i czytasz go lordowi Nedowi na głos. Każde zdanie to nowy cios: podniebna cela, sąd, pojedynek.
tasks.q_en: Lady Catelyn promised to write to you about everything. This time her letter has come from the Eyrie, and you read it aloud to Lord Ned. Every sentence is a new blow: the sky cell, the trial, the duel.

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Some verbs are followed by -ing (gerund): enjoy, avoid, admit, deny, keep, mind, risk: Tyrion avoids looking down. Others by to + verb (infinitive): refuse, agree, demand, decide, promise, want: He refuses to confess. After prepositions always -ing: afraid of falling. Stop doing = no longer do it; stop to do = stop in order to do something else.
tasks.q_pl: Some verbs are followed by -ing (gerund): enjoy, avoid, admit, deny, keep, mind, risk: Tyrion avoids looking down. Others by to + verb (infinitive): refuse, agree, demand, decide, promise, want: He refuses to confess. After prepositions always -ing: afraid of falling. Stop doing = no longer do it; stop to do = stop in order to do something else.
tasks.q_en: Some verbs are followed by -ing (gerund): enjoy, avoid, admit, deny, keep, mind, risk: Tyrion avoids looking down. Others by to + verb (infinitive): refuse, agree, demand, decide, promise, want: He refuses to confess. After prepositions always -ing: afraid of falling. Stop doing = no longer do it; stop to do = stop in order to do something else.

end_good.text: Нед довго мовчить, а потім кладе руку тобі на плече. «Тіріон на волі, а Тайвін збирає військо. Тепер усе залежить від того, що зробить король». За вікном б'є дзвін.
end_good.text_pl: Ned długo milczy, a potem kładzie ci rękę na ramieniu. „Tyrion jest wolny, a Tywin zbiera wojsko. Teraz wszystko zależy od tego, co zrobi król”. Za oknem bije dzwon.
end_good.text_en: Ned is silent for a long time, then puts his hand on your shoulder. “Tyrion is free, and Tywin is gathering an army. Now everything depends on what the king does.” Outside, a bell is ringing.
